title: Part 3: African Traditional Dance | Learning To Dance Adowa in Kumasi - Ghana

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates traditional Adowa dance movements step by step alongside students. She provides verbal counts and rhythms while encouraging practice.

lesson_structure.note: Three women demonstrate the traditional Adowa dance with drumming.
Teacher breaks down footwork and hand movements facing the camera.
Slow practice of footwork counting out loud.

steps_taught.name: Adowa Basic Footwork
steps_taught.description: Bending knees and shifting weight with foot taps to the drum beat.

what_hinders: Camera angles sometimes shift away from foot placement

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates foot tapping and arm gestures while standing next to a student.
Close-up shot on foot positioning and rhythmic stepping.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: upper body posture details during close-up

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating live traditional drumming directly into the instructional breakdown.
